findings.message: evals.yaml must be a mapping with `cases: [ ... ]`.
Description MUST include WHAT the skill does and WHEN to use it (trigger contexts).
findings.evidence: description: Route broad frontend design requests to the correct local UI skill after classifying intent and maturity. Use when the user asks for frontend design generally and the specific design owner is not yet clear.

findings.message: Constraints/Safety MUST mention redaction of secrets/sensitive data by default.

Examples look abstract or template-like. Prefer realistic user requests and concrete workflows.
